name: LSPosed/Xposed Maps Scan
description: Scans /proc/self/maps for LSPosed, Xposed, EdXposed, and Riru framework libraries loaded into the process memory.

evidenceUnits.title: LSPosed or Xposed process-map marker
evidenceUnits.observedObject: Mapped paths and names in the current process
evidenceUnits.proposition: A process mapping matches a maintained LSPosed, Xposed, EdXposed, or Riru marker
evidenceUnits.availability: Depends on maps readability and marker visibility in the target process
evidenceUnits.trustBoundary: The process map view and parser can be filtered or hooked
evidenceUnits.inferenceLimit: A marker supports framework presence in this process but not module scope or system-wide activation
